method: ShadowVeil: deadline-aware scheduling of exact counterfactual recurrent-state reconstruction

mamba2_portability_check.interpretation: Single-configuration mechanism portability check (boundary + continuation equality), matching the tier used for the original Mamba-370M check. Not a privacy confirmation; no attacker trained.

subspace_editing_baseline.reading: Projection suppresses probes on the edited coordinates but leaves signal in disjoint coordinates and does not generalize to identities absent from defense training.

sanitizer_ablation.fixed_placeholder: preserves privacy but shifts the retained probe more on Enron
sanitizer_ablation.sixteen_surrogate_pool: reduces semantic distortion but injects nuisance identity variation
sanitizer_ablation.selected: one disjoint natural pseudonym with tokenizer length matched to all protected names

scope: Exactness is relative to the declared sanitized input stream, the recorded execution schedule and the batch geometry; it is not a statement about inferences from correlated public context.
Revoking w items whose expiry order is unknown requires 2^w concurrent branches under the stated service model.
The runtime revokes Mamba cache state, not model weights, logs, host-language strings, tool state or generated output.
Attackers read seeded coordinates, the full cache, next-token logits or greedy generations; adaptive fine-tuned attackers are not evaluated.
Measurements use one laptop GPU and an in-repository Triton continuation; windows reach 8,192 tokens.
